name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the CopilotKit quickstart end-to-end: created the Next.js app, installed all three CopilotKit packages, configured the `.env`, wrote the `app/api/copilotkit/route.ts` runtime endpoint, and wrapped the layout with the `CopilotKit` provider. The **copilot endpoint demonstrably works**—a `POST` to `/api/copilotkit` returned a valid JSON error `{"error":"invalid_request","message":"Unsupported method 'test'"}` and the server logs showed `[CopilotKit Runtime] anonymous telemetry enabled`, proving the `BuiltInAgent` and `CopilotRuntime` initialized and are handling requests. What blocked completion was the **frontend never compiled or served**: the Next.js dev server repeatedly hung on `○ Compiling / ...` and was killed, almost certainly because the 1 GB cgroup memory limit is insufficient for Turbopack to compile the CopilotKit React components. I also had to deviate from the docs by using a placeholder `OPENAI_API_KEY` since no real key was exported in the sandbox environment.

installed.evidence: npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/react-ui @copilotkit/runtime: added 856 packages, and audited 1222 packages in 2m
